name: Sds 8/5 dual laser cannon
description: The Sds 8/5 dual laser cannon was a model of laser cannon manufactured by Taim & Bak. Two Sds 8/5 dual laser cannons were equipped on Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptors, a model of interceptor prevalently utilized by the Jedi Order.
